steps.prompt:
Revise this Chinese planetary game UI into its DEFAULT WATCHING STATE, emphasizing the planet and using the EMPTY SPACE BESIDE ITS ROUND OUTLINE for small stable controls. One full-window1440x900 work canvas, LEFT808px planetary module (56.11%), RIGHT632px reference battlefield(43.89%). Reference2 is the original exact split/style. Reference1 supplies the existing scene, grounded refinery/workshop, station and scaffold shipyard, but its LARGE BOTTOM CONTROL CONSOLE IS REJECTED and must be completely removed.

Reference3 actual refinery = two horizontal ivory/ochre cylinders beside teal center. Reference4 actual workshop = compact cream PRESS, ochre top, teal plinth. Reference5 actual space station = compact ivory hub, cyan top and two broad solid blue wings. Preserve silhouettes. Do not design new ships/shields on the right; right battlefield remains contextual reference only.

MANDATORY STRUCTURAL CHANGE:
Remove the ENTIRE bottom cream console, facility ledger/table, four facility rows, disabled reforge block, gift/buff buttons and right-side empty placeholders. Restore that whole lower area to continuous deep-teal orbital space extending to the bottom of the module. NO full-width bottom control strip. NO new white sidebar, generic cards or frame around the globe. The scene occupies virtually all module space below the compact global masthead/navigation.

Use a compact instrument group in the LEFT-UPPER OUTSIDE gap of the circular planet, and ONE small facility-management entry in the RIGHT-UPPER OUTSIDE gap. These are stable screen controls, independent of building positions. They must NOT follow or overlap moving objects. Keep orbital objects and scout approach/flight corridors clear; put controls outside their visible envelopes, not on the orbit paths.

Planet center about(375,440), diameter about380-400px at the1440 client scale. DO NOT enlarge it to compensate for removing controls. Full circular body visible, substantial surrounding orbital space. Same broad teal oceans, cream/olive continent geography and sparse independent cloud bands, fixed upper-left light/darker lower-right, subdued atmosphere. Surface refinery rests on its lower-front landmass with contact shadow/local tangent, no floating icon. Suggested grounded workshop on left land near limb. Orbiting station separated from terrain; suggested unfinished U-shaped shipyard in fixed near-orbit space; scout follows projected orbit tangent with short wake. Buildings only watching/status, NO labels, buttons, click halos, tracking callouts or leader lines attached to buildings. Tiny amber readiness beacon on refinery is enough. No asteroids.

LEFT STABLE EXPLORATION INSTRUMENT GROUP:
Use approx x24..170,y205..360 in the1440 work canvas, outside the globe footprint and clear of orbital traffic. Compact text and three small vertically stacked controls directly on the scene, not enclosed in a large card:
“探索中 · 本次68%”
smaller “自动探索 · 开启”
small fixed button “人员1”
teal fixed button “本次完成后停止”
separate quiet outline button “立即取消探索”
All Chinese legible; do not shrink it to unreadable tiny type. Subtle ivory control surfaces and pale state text on the deep-teal field. No extra tutorial or status paragraph. No extra empty background box.

RIGHT-UPPER STABLE ENTRY:
At approx x620..790,y175..230 put ONE compact ivory button “设施管理” with restrained amber badge “1待领取”. Its small footprint should fit the circle's outside gap, above and clear of station/scout traffic. No facility names/list/details in default view, no reforge/buff area. Nothing expands in this DEFAULT state.

Top edge retains compact ivory masthead“远航舰桥”, resource facts“铁128.6M 铀8.4M 碎片2.1K”, status“交战中”, small暂停; one compact nav row“装备 反应炉 科研 船员 星球 星系”,星球 selected. Scene title“始源星 E178b”,“探索度68”,small previous/next controls. These are the only other UI. No degree progress bar.

Same sample world: D68, explorer1,auto on,task68%; station/workshopbuilt,refineryready,shipyardbuilding38/180,extra builder1. Details are deliberately COLLAPSED; only1待领取 remains discoverable. This is a design image, not implemented software. Workshop-ground and shipyard-near-orbit are unconfirmed design suggestions and will be described OUTSIDE the image, not as product labels. No design headings/timestamps in the product.

FULL WINDOW edge to edge, no presentation margin. Preserve gentle ivory/deep teal visual language. Give the planet/terrain/orbits the space previously occupied by the rejected big bottom console.

Make the FACILITY DRAWER OPEN state of this exact default-watching game UI. This is the SAME INSTANT: same camera, planet size/center, continent/cloud phase, ground building positions, orbital station/dock/scout positions, left exploration controls, masthead/navigation and right battlefield. Do NOT recenter, enlarge or move any scene object. No simulated time passes and no claim is performed.

ONLY change the small “设施管理 / 1待领取” entry at upper-right of the LEFT module into a COMPACT RIGHT-EDGE DRAWER anchored to that same location. This is not a full-height sidebar or bottom console.

For this reference image around1586x992, keep drawer roughly within native x790..1000 and y205..495 (about210px wide by290px tall), fully left of the divider. Nominal work-canvas target is approximately210–230px wide by240–280px tall; this is a narrow content-fit panel. The planet must remain almost entirely visible. Leave the lower-right dock/scout orbital corridor and whole lower module open. Minor rear orbit can pass behind this temporary panel, but do not move the path or place controls on top of the main traffic. Preserve the entire left exploration instrument group and all buttons in their exact existing positions.

DRAWER CONTENT, one selected facility only:
Warm ivory, restrained thin teal edge and shallow structural shadow, no extra card nesting and no unused blank area.
Header “设施管理” and small “收起” at upper-right.
One compact selector row “精炼厂 ▾” (this is where other facilities can be selected; do NOT show all four facility rows).
Status “待领取” in restrained amber, smaller actual completion count “施工 5 / 5 次”.
One clear amber action “领取”.
Below a thin separator, two compact low-frequency entries: “累计加成” and disabled “重铸预览”, with small disabled reason “船坞未领取”.
All concise readable Chinese, no tutorials, no formula/buff predictions or invented income. The claimant refinery remains ready/unclaimed in the scene with amber beacon; buttons do not trigger a visual claim. No other facility detail or personnel table.

The panel should feel like an observation-scene edge drawer using the circular planet's outside gap, not a generic dashboard sidebar. It closes without leaving a reserved area in the default view. Do NOT add a full-width bottom strip, facility ledger, four cards, right empty placeholder or new footer. No labels/buttons/interaction markers attached to buildings.

Everything else is UNCHANGED from the reference: task68%, degree68, explorer1,auto开启, grounded refinery/workshop, station in orbit, unfinished fixed near-orbit U-shaped dock38/180 (count hidden while refineryselected), right battlefield solely reference. No choosing shader/mesh route. No product explanation, P3/P4 labels or timestamps. This single image is the opened management state, not an alternative redesign.

Make ONE concentrated simplification of ONLY the OPEN FACILITY DRAWER in this reference image. Preserve every other part of the image: world/planet/globe size, continents/clouds/light, all buildings and ships, all left exploration controls, masthead/navigation and right battlefield. Default-watching image is separately frozen and must not be redesigned. No scene/camera change and no time/claim progression.

Current drawer is too tall, with redundant completion status and large secondary entries. Keep its upper-right anchor and approximately the same width, but SHORTEN it by about one quarter to one third, aiming around x738..998 and y136..400 in the current1586x992 image. This is a compact temporary edge drawer, not a new sidebar. Modest temporary overlap of planet edge/rear orbit is acceptable; do NOT promise or try to make zero overlap by moving the world.

Retain text readability: preserve the current main body text size, use proper wrapping and hierarchy, NOT overall shrinking of fonts. This is also the principle for the future808px module: reflow content, do not scale the whole interface down.

Replace drawer contents with EXACTLY this concise hierarchy:
1. Compact header “设施管理” and small “收起”.
2. ONE compact selected-facility row combining name/status/selector: “精炼厂 · 待领取 ▾”. No separate oversized amber waiting badge.
3. The NECESSARY BENEFIT of claiming, in two readable short lines:
“领取后生效：”
“铁、铀原生掉落加成”
This is the rule's qualitative effect, not a new amount/rate. Do NOT invent “×1.2”, percentages, income per second, prices or any calculated prediction.
4. ONE clearly primary amber “领取” button, same readable label and a normal usable height.
5. A thin separator, then ONE low-emphasis text entry “更多 · 加成与重铸 ›”.
The secondary entry represents on-demand access to cumulative bonuses and reforge conditions. Do NOT show a big cumulative-bonus row, a permanently disabled reforge block, or “船坞未领取” taking separate visible space in this refinery claim view. Their details belong inside the secondary menu.
REMOVE “施工5/5次” from this ready-to-claim view; ready state already communicates completion, and the current decision needs the effect and claim action. No extra descriptions or tutorial.
No unused blank footer or duplicate facility title, no four-facility table.

The refinery remains ready/unclaimed; pressing a button has not been demonstrated. Buildings remain purely visual and there are no building click hotspots or tracking controls. Everything outside this drawer stays unchanged. This is a refinement of the existing opened state, not a new UI direction or new game mechanic.
